io.milvus.common.utils

Class RoaringBitmapUtils.Builder

  • java.lang.Object
    • io.milvus.common.utils.RoaringBitmapUtils.Builder
  • Enclosing class:
    RoaringBitmapUtils

    public static class RoaringBitmapUtils.Builder
extends Object
    Incrementally collects members and serializes them into an MRB1 blob. Not thread-safe.

    Prefer this over RoaringBitmapUtils.buildRoaringBitmap(List) for very large membership sets: add(long) takes a primitive, so a 10M-member bitmap costs no boxed List<Long> (which would be roughly 240 MB of Long objects on its own).

    build() may be called repeatedly and after further add calls; it returns a fresh array each time and never mutates one it already handed out.
